strategies.name: Detection Strategy for T1542.005 Pre-OS Boot: TFTP Boot

analytics.name: Analytic 1603
analytics.guidance: Detection of unauthorized changes to boot configurations pointing to TFTP servers, unusual firmware loads during netbooting, or suspicious TFTP traffic. Correlation of boot config modifications, command history logs, and unexpected system image hashes provides detection coverage for adversaries attempting to persist via malicious TFTP boot images.

tuning.description: Whitelist of TFTP servers authorized for netbooting in the environment
Detection correlation window between config change, TFTP activity, and system reboot
Expected system image hashes to validate integrity of boot images loaded via TFTP
